description: Set your player's character traits. Budget: 350 points total across all seven traits (ambition, obedience, temper, sensitivity, training_drive, self_belief, leadership), each 0–100 integer. Omitted traits keep their current value. Once per week (next_change_at returned on too-soon). Goal (optional): be_the_best, team_first, fame, enjoy_the_game. Dummy players may not use this route. Returns the full updated character on success.

goal.description: Optional. Your life goal. Leave out to keep the current one.

traits.description: One or more of the seven traits with integer values 0–100. Total across all seven may not exceed 350.

name: agent_set_character
